title: Kissed Indian Rice Dosa
description: A light, herbal rice dosa with Jamaican curry powder and a citrus-honey glaze, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk rice flour, urad dal flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually stir in coconut water until a smooth batter forms.
Fold in jamaican curry powder, chopped onion, tomato, cilantro, and lemon juice, mixing until evenly distributed.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Heat a donabe over medium heat and brush with a thin layer of coconut oil.
Pour a ladleful of batter into the center of the pot, swirling to coat the bottom in a thin circle.
Cover the pot with a lid and cook for 5 minutes until the edges lift and the surface is set.
Flip the dosa gently and cook for an additional 2 minutes, then remove and place on a plate.
In a small bowl, whisk honey with a splash of coconut water to create a light glaze.
Drizzle the glaze over the warm dosa and serve immediately.
